verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a metered, key-based SaaS API with a paid proxy option, so a spending cap or usage alert is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence shows no account-level budget cap, credit threshold, or usage alert. The `x-max-tokens` header only trims the size of a single response and is not documented as a billing or budget control, and community users note the site doesn't even mention API limits.
